chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Hajjaj, who said:
Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: 'Give charity and go out on whichever day you desire.'
ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq say about giving charity and leaving the house?
ai.summary: In this concise hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) highlights the spiritual ease and flexibility of giving charity, encouraging believers to act without delay or rigid scheduling. This reflects the Shia emphasis on the immediacy of good deeds (*al-fawr*) and the removal of barriers to voluntary charity (*sadaqah*), reinforcing its role as a means of purifying wealth and seeking divine proximity.

en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Mahboub,from Abdul Rahman Bin Al Hajjal who said,
‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Give charity and go out in whichever day you so desire to’.
en.sarwar: 4. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ibn Mahbub from ‘Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Hajjaj who has said the following: “
Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘You should give charity and leave for your journey any time you like.’”
